1. While building, check a few moments without rendering: `hyperframes diff <video> . --at t,t,…`.
2. When every shot has content: `hyperframes check` and fix its errors. Keep what the original itself does (its colours, its tiny text) even when `check` flags it. Then `hyperframes cloud render --fps <data-fps> --quality high -o <out>` and `hyperframes diff <video> <out>`. A fractional rate, a frame not 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, or a failed cloud render (tell the person why) renders locally: `hyperframes render -o <out>` in the foreground with a 10-minute timeout (longer: start it detached, `setsid nohup hyperframes render -o <out> > render.log 2>&1 &`, and wait on the log in the foreground). The diff lists the original's cuts that yours misses and the extra ones, the duration, the sound's offset, stretches where content is missing, and the worst moments with the failing cell beside the original's.
